currentUserGoal: Prevent mobile/tablet board views from showing partial tiles or letting tiles overlap the board borders.
changesMade: Added whole-tile viewport sizing for compact and tablet-width board layouts.
Quantized the board content area to exact tile visual sizes so the mask lands on tile-cell boundaries.
Changed compact/tablet culling to only render tiles whose base tile fits fully inside the board content area.
Snapped compact/tablet board panning to tile increments so touch dragging cannot land between tile columns or rows.
Changed the compact/tablet tile mask from rounded to rectangular inside the ornate frame so corner tiles are not shaved by the mask radius.
Bumped the mobile test URL version to whole-tiles-1.
